Vous n'avez plus le droit de franchir le seuil de la glorieuse famille Ushiromiya !!
Quittez ces lieux sur-le-champ !!
Immédiatement !!
Dehors !!"

en: "You tell me to stand down?  Me, Ushiromiya Eva, the third ranked in the Ushiromiya family hierarchy and the one allowed to sit at the left shoulder of the Head?!!
Know your place!!
And then look at your shabby self in a mirror!!
Where is the symbol of the wing on your clothes?
Where are you permitted to wear the One-Winged Eagle?
Aren't you nothing more than a borrowed womb to house the next Successor to the Ushiromiya family?!!
Understand your place, you common housemaid!!"
"Heck yeah, it's a lot.
Maria, you love shortcake, right?  You could buy more shortcake than you could possibly eat for the rest of your life."
ancien_en: "Heck yeah, it's a lot.
Maria, you love shortcake, right?
You could buy more shortcake than you could possibly eat for the rest of your life."
ancien_fr: "Carrément que c'est beaucoup.
Maria, t'adores les fraisiers, hein ?
Tu pourrais acheter plus de fraisiers que t'en pourrais jamais manger de toute ta vie."

en: "I see.
......So, in other words, this witch lent Grandfather the funds necessary to revive the Ushiromiya family, and he owed her big time.
...And then, he felt so grateful that he had that huge painting drawn and displayed...  Yeah, it's not that crazy a story."
ancien_en: "I see.
......So, in other words, this witch lent Grandfather the funds necessary to revive the Ushiromiya family, and he owed her big time.
...And then, he felt so grateful that he had that huge painting drawn and displayed...
Yeah, it's not that crazy a story."
ancien_fr: "Je vois.
......Donc, en gros, cette sorcière a prêté à Grand-père les fonds nécessaires pour relever la famille Ushiromiya, et il avait une sacrée dette envers elle.
...Et du coup, il lui était tellement reconnaissant qu'il a fait peindre cet immense tableau pour l'exposer...
Ouais, c'est pas une histoire si dingue que ça."

en: "Nii-san, you've gathered a massive supply of funds.  That's a fact.
If we rule out the possibility that you've been embezzling Father's personal funds,
...then there's only one possibility left, right?"
ancien_en: "Nii-san, you've gathered a massive supply of funds.
That's a fact.
If we rule out the possibility that you've been embezzling Father's personal funds,
...then there's only one possibility left, right?"
ancien_fr: "Nii-san, tu as réuni une quantité colossale de fonds.
C'est un fait.
Si on écarte la possibilité que tu détournes l'argent personnel de Père,
...alors il ne reste plus qu'une seule possibilité, non ?"

en: "......Nii-san, you found 10 tons of gold
and used that as collateral to gather some funding.
...Yes, just like Father did in the past, right?"
ancien_en: "......Nii-san, you found 10 tons of gold and used that as collateral to gather some funding.
...Yes, just like Father did in the past, right?"
ancien_fr: "......Nii-san, tu as trouvé les 10 tonnes d'or et tu t'en es servi comme garantie pour réunir des fonds.
...Oui, exactement comme Père l'a fait autrefois, n'est-ce pas ?"

en: "......What do you think, Krauss nii-san?  This is an ideal chance for you to restore the trust regarding your handling of Father's assets, isn't it?!
Of course, it might be impossible to get a whole 7.5 billion before Father dies,
but it should be possible for you to manage a deposit of 750 million, right?"
ancien_en: "......What do you think, Krauss nii-san?
This is an ideal chance for you to restore the trust regarding your handling of Father's assets, isn't it?!
Of course, it might be impossible to get a whole 7.5 billion before Father dies,
but it should be possible for you to manage a deposit of 750 million, right?"
ancien_fr: "......Qu'est-ce que t'en dis, Krauss nii-san ?
C'est l'occasion idéale de rétablir la confiance quant à ta gestion des biens de Père, non ?!
Évidemment, réunir 7,5 milliards d'un coup avant la mort de Père, c'est sûrement impossible,
mais un acompte de 750 millions, tu devrais pouvoir t'en sortir, non ?"

en: "Shouldn't deals be made between those on even footings?
From my perspective, this deal will help restore the long-lost trust of my younger siblings and deepen the love between us.
It's an old problem that's been eating at me, and one I would prefer to resolve as soon as possible.
I would be overjoyed if we could resolve it today.
.........However, it seems I'm not the only one who'd be quite glad to close this deal quickly.  Am I wrong...?"
ancien_en: "Shouldn't deals be made between those on even footings?
From my perspective, this deal will help restore the long-lost trust of my younger siblings and deepen the love between us.
It's an old problem that's been eating at me, and one I would prefer to resolve as soon as possible.
I would be overjoyed if we could resolve it today.
.........However, it seems I'm not the only one who'd be quite glad to close this deal quickly.
Am I wrong...?"
ancien_fr: "Les marchés ne devraient-ils pas se conclure d'égal à égal ?
De mon point de vue, ce marché contribuera à restaurer la confiance depuis longtemps perdue de mes cadets et à approfondir l'affection entre nous.
C'est un vieux problème qui me ronge, et que je préférerais résoudre au plus vite.
Je serais ravi que nous puissions le résoudre aujourd'hui.
.........Cependant, il semble que je ne sois pas le seul à être bien content de conclure ce marché rapidement.
Est-ce que je me trompe... ?"

en: "......If you put it like that, then the part about reviving lost love
might refer to the pair torn apart on the second twilight."
ancien_en: "......If you put it like that, then the part about reviving lost love might refer to the pair torn apart on the second twilight."
ancien_fr: "......Dit comme ça, le passage sur la résurrection de l'amour perdu désigne peut-être le couple déchiré au deuxième crépuscule."

en: "Someone commuting to school or work on a train packed to twice its capacity might carelessly think that
commuting by boat would be pretty interesting and fun,
but it sounds like it comes with troubles of its own."
ancien_en: "Someone commuting to school or work on a train packed to twice its capacity might carelessly think that commuting by boat would be pretty interesting and fun,
but it sounds like it comes with troubles of its own."
ancien_fr: "Quelqu'un qui va à l'école ou au travail dans un train bondé au double de sa capacité pourrait penser à la légère qu'aller en cours en bateau serait plutôt intéressant et amusant,
mais on dirait que ça a aussi ses inconvénients."

en: "Umm,
...a short while back, Maria was in the rose garden when it started raining,
and she apparently borrowed a white umbrella from someone.  I wanted to thank them..."
ancien_en: "Umm,
...a short while back, Maria was in the rose garden when it started raining,
and she apparently borrowed a white umbrella from someone.
I wanted to thank them..."
ancien_fr: "Euh,
...tout à l'heure, Maria était dans la roseraie quand il s'est mis à pleuvoir,
et apparemment, quelqu'un lui a prêté un parapluie blanc.
Je voulais remercier cette personne..."

en: "Then Kanon-kun came, and he asked whether Maria was with us.  That's when we first realized she wasn't in the mansion.
I mean, if it were me, I'd have grabbed her hand and pulled her under a roof before giving her an umbrella."
ancien_en: "Then Kanon-kun came, and he asked whether Maria was with us.
That's when we first realized she wasn't in the mansion.
I mean, if it were me, I'd have grabbed her hand and pulled her under a roof before giving her an umbrella."
ancien_fr: "Puis Kanon-kun est venu, et il nous a demandé si Maria était avec nous.
C'est là qu'on a compris qu'elle n'était pas au manoir.
Et puis, si ça avait été moi, je l'aurais attrapée par la main et tirée sous un toit plutôt que de lui donner un parapluie."

en: "......How foolish...  What nonsense...!"
ancien_en: "......How foolish...
What nonsense...!"
ancien_fr: "......Quelle bêtise...
Quelles sornettes... !"

en: "Special clause.
Beatrice retains the right to collect the gold and accumulated interest upon the termination of the contract.
However, if someone is able to discover the hidden gold of this contract,
Beatrice must abandon these rights for all time."
ancien_en: "Special clause.
Beatrice retains the right to collect the gold and accumulated interest upon the termination of the contract.
However, if someone is able to discover the hidden gold of this contract, Beatrice must abandon these rights for all time."
ancien_fr: "Clause spéciale.
Beatrice conserve le droit de récupérer l'or et les intérêts accumulés à la résiliation du contrat.
Toutefois, si quelqu'un parvient à découvrir l'or caché du présent contrat, Beatrice devra renoncer à ces droits à tout jamais."

en: "How foolish!  Such assets could not possibly exist!"

Such assets could not possibly exist!"
ancien_fr: "Quelle bêtise !
De tels biens ne peuvent pas exister !"

en: ...a wife
means to you......?!"
ancien_en: ...a wife means to you......?!"
ancien_fr: ...ce qu'une épouse représente pour vous......?!"

en: "Ah, that's right.
We were planning to play cards or something.  Would you care to join us for a bit?"
ancien_en: "Ah, that's right.
We were planning to play cards or something.
Would you care to join us for a bit?"
ancien_fr: "Ah, c'est vrai.
On avait prévu de jouer aux cartes ou quelque chose comme ça.
Ça te dirait de te joindre à nous un moment ?"

en: "Ah, is that so...?  That's a relief.
I was just about to go check that the mansion was fully locked up, but I felt uneasy about leaving this room unmanned.
After all, Krauss-sama and the others' meeting looks as though it will continue for quite some time.
They might request some tea at any moment."
ancien_en: "Ah, is that so...?
That's a relief.
I was just about to go check that the mansion was fully locked up, but I felt uneasy about leaving this room unmanned.
After all, Krauss-sama and the others' meeting looks as though it will continue for quite some time.
They might request some tea at any moment."
ancien_fr: "Ah, vraiment... ?
Voilà qui me soulage.
J'allais justement vérifier que le manoir était bien fermé à clé, mais je n'étais pas tranquille à l'idée de laisser cette pièce sans personne.
Après tout, la réunion de Krauss-sama et des autres a l'air partie pour durer un bon moment.
Ils pourraient demander du thé à tout instant."

en: "...George nii-san, you really are an adult.  I respect that..."
ancien_en: "...George nii-san, you really are an adult.
I respect that..."
ancien_fr: "...George nii-san, t'es vraiment un adulte.
Je te respecte, sérieux..."

en: "......Last night, I came here before it started raining, and there was nothing drawn here at that time."
ancien_en: "......There was nothing drawn here when I came by yesterday, before it started raining."
ancien_fr: "......Il n'y avait rien de dessiné ici quand je suis passé hier, avant qu'il ne commence à pleuvoir."

I'm a general practitioner! Examining corpses is outside my area of expertise...!"

L'examen des cadavres dépasse mon domaine de compétence... !"

I wonder when he left his room...
Do any of you have an idea?"
ancien_en: "...That is correct.
I was surprised myself...
I wonder when he left his room...
Do any of you have an idea?"
ancien_fr: "...C'est exact.
J'en ai moi-même été surprise...
Je me demande quand il a quitté sa chambre...
L'un d'entre vous a-t-il une idée ?"

en: "Battler-kun,
let's leave him be."
ancien_en: "Battler-kun, let's leave him be."
ancien_fr: "Battler-kun, laissons-le tranquille."

en: "It's reasonable to think that the culprit...no, culprits...are multiple in number and fairly well armed.
They'd have to be, wouldn't they?
They had to assault the four in the dining hall and kill them, drag a total of six bodies all the way to the storehouse beyond the rose garden,
and arrange for that disgusting makeup and the graffiti on the shutter.
......There's no way that a single culprit could carry out all of that on their own, right?"
ancien_en: "It's reasonable to think that the culprit...no, culprits...are multiple in number and fairly well armed.
They'd have to be, wouldn't they?

They had to assault the four in the dining hall and kill them, drag a total of six bodies all the way to the storehouse beyond the rose garden, and arrange for that disgusting makeup and the graffiti on the shutter.
......There's no way that a single culprit could carry out all of that on their own, right?"
ancien_fr: "Il est raisonnable de penser que le coupable... non, les coupables... sont plusieurs et plutôt bien armés.
Il le faut bien, tu ne crois pas ?

Ils ont dû attaquer les quatre de la salle à manger et les tuer, traîner six corps en tout jusqu'à la remise au-delà de la roseraie, et s'occuper de ce maquillage répugnant et des graffitis sur le rideau métallique.
......Un coupable seul n'aurait jamais pu faire tout ça, n'est-ce pas ?"

en: "Could you tell me a bit more
about last night?"
ancien_en: "Could you tell me a bit more about last night?"
ancien_fr: "Vous pourriez m'en dire un peu plus sur hier soir ?"

en: "There's no mistake, that's it.  I'm sure there were characters that looked like that...!
How were you able to write somethin' like that...?"
ancien_en: "There's no mistake, that's it.
I'm sure there were characters that looked like that...!
How were you able to write somethin' like that...?"
ancien_fr: "Pas d'erreur, c'est ça.
Je suis sûr qu'y avait des caractères qui ressemblaient à ça... !
Comment t'as fait pour écrire un truc pareil... ?"

en: "...That's incredible.  I'm surprised...
...So, what meaning does this magic circle have?"
ancien_en: "...That's incredible.
I'm surprised...
...So, what meaning does this magic circle have?"
ancien_fr: "...C'est incroyable.
Je suis surpris...
...Et donc, quelle est la signification de ce cercle magique ?"

en: ...and gain freedom...?
It sounds deep..."
ancien_en: ...and gain freedom...?  It sounds deep..."

and tried to open the door,

que Beatrice-sama est venue rendre visite à la chambre de Madame...
et a essayé d'ouvrir la porte,

en: "Hesitating, huh?  Not very manly of you.
Whatever it is you're talking about, it's even more unpleasant having it kept a secret.
ancien_en: "Hesitating, huh?
Not very manly of you.

en: "I got it from Beatrice.  How many times must I tell you before you understand?
ancien_en: "I got it from Beatrice.
How many times must I tell you before you understand?
ancien_fr: "C'est Beatrice qui me l'a donnée.
Combien de fois faudra-t-il te le dire pour que tu comprennes ?

en: !sd@
ancien_en: Sorry, but I can't believe in something as shady as Beatrice until I've seen her with my own eyes...!!"
ancien_fr: Désolé, mais je peux pas croire à un truc aussi louche que Beatrice tant que je l'aurai pas vue de mes propres yeux... !!"

en: "......Jessica,
@:dwave_eng 0, but_1e989:
@:dwave_eng 0, but_1e990:
ancien_en: "......Jessica, all I know about the story of the witch...is that the adults made it up to keep the kids too scared to enter the forest,
...but is the story different here in the mansion...?"
ancien_fr: "......Jessica, tout ce que je sais de l'histoire de la sorcière... c'est que les adultes l'ont inventée pour que les gamins aient trop peur pour entrer dans la forêt,
...mais ici, au manoir, l'histoire est différente... ?"

en: "In addition, some servants have also seen will-o'-the-wisps and glittering butterflies dancing around.
...Kanon-kun also saw something like that when he went patrolling one night.
And recently, you often hear servants talking about strange footsteps heard inside the mansion near midnight.
We've whispered together that the Beatrice-sama in the portrait sometimes makes herself invisible and walks through the mansion.
...It happened a while ago, but even I have heard footsteps while patrolling at night that resemble these stories."
ancien_en: "In addition, some servants have also seen will-o'-the-wisps and glittering butterflies dancing around.
...Kanon-kun also saw something like that when he went patrolling one night.
And recently, you often hear servants talking about strange footsteps heard inside the mansion near midnight.
We've whispered together that the Beatrice-sama in the portrait sometimes makes herself invisible and walks through the mansion.
...It happened a while ago,
but even I have heard footsteps while patrolling at night that resemble these stories."
ancien_fr: "Par ailleurs, certains domestiques ont aussi vu des feux follets et des papillons scintillants voleter.
...Kanon-kun aussi a vu quelque chose de ce genre en faisant sa ronde, une nuit.
Et ces derniers temps, on entend souvent les domestiques parler de bruits de pas étranges dans le manoir, aux alentours de minuit.
Nous nous sommes murmuré entre nous que la Beatrice-sama du portrait se rend parfois invisible pour se promener dans le manoir.
...Ça remonte à un moment,
mais même moi, pendant une ronde de nuit, j'ai entendu des bruits de pas qui ressemblaient à ces histoires."

en: "...If you don't respect her, you'll suffer her wrath and get hurt.
...So, to the servants,
@:dwave_eng 0, but_1e995:
ancien_en: "...If you don't respect her, you'll suffer her wrath and get hurt.
...So, to the servants, Beatrice's existence is just as credible as the story that, if you pull pranks on Inari-san, you'll receive Kitsune-sama's curse."
ancien_fr: "...Si on ne la respecte pas, on subit sa colère et on se blesse.
...Donc, pour les domestiques, l'existence de Beatrice est aussi crédible que l'histoire selon laquelle, si on fait des farces à Inari-san, on s'attire la malédiction de Kitsune-sama."

en: "...There is no hidden gold.
However, if the culprit is blindly sure of its existence,
and if they're trying to make us solve the riddle before snatching the gold away for themselves, then I will agree it makes sense."
ancien_en: "...There is no hidden gold.
However, if the culprit is blindly sure of its existence,
and if they're trying to make us solve the riddle before snatching the gold away for themselves,
then I will agree it makes sense."
ancien_fr: "...Il n'y a pas d'or caché.
Cependant, si le coupable croit aveuglément à son existence,
et s'il cherche à nous faire résoudre l'énigme avant de s'emparer de l'or pour lui-même,
alors je veux bien admettre que cela se tient."

en: "What about Doctor Nanjo?  You've had a close relationship with Father."
ancien_en: "What about Doctor Nanjo?
You've had a close relationship with Father."
ancien_fr: "Et vous, Docteur Nanjo ?
Vous avez toujours été très proche de Père."

en: "L-Like hell she'd lie about that.  Mom's guiltless!!
Why would she lie?!!"
ancien_en: "L-Like hell she'd lie about that.
Mom's guiltless!!
Why would she lie?!!"
ancien_fr: "T-Tu parles qu'elle mentirait là-dessus.
Maman est innocente !!
Pourquoi est-ce qu'elle mentirait ?!!"

en: "What's this?
Are you going to shoot me with that gun?
Go ahead.
If only you'd just shoot!
You're just desperate because you can't think of a way out, right?!
Do it, just try to obscure the truth with violence...!!"
"After that, when you left and said you were going to check the doors and windows,
you took Father's corpse, which had fallen in the courtyard, and hid it!
"...Oh my.  Well, how do you think anyone could break through the door sealed by my receipt and make Father disappear?  Other than by my theory?!"
ancien_en: "...Oh my.
Well, how do you think anyone could break through the door sealed by my receipt and make Father disappear?
Other than by my theory?!"
ancien_fr: "...Oh là là.
Eh bien, comment crois-tu que quelqu'un aurait pu franchir la porte scellée par mon ticket et faire disparaître Père ?
À part avec ma théorie ?!"

en: "But the thing that really pisses me off...
is how you're pressuring Aunt Natsuhi to explain it, then claiming that she must be guilty if she doesn't!
If you wanna go down that road, then why don't you let me,
Ushiromiya Battler, spin the chessboard around one more time?!!"
"Then none of that either!
...How does it sound?  Just the two of us, taking it easy like when we were newlyweds, just before George was born."
ancien_en: "Then none of that either!
...How does it sound?
Just the two of us, taking it easy like when we were newlyweds, just before George was born."
ancien_fr: "Alors rien de tout ça non plus !
...Qu'est-ce que t'en dis ?
Rien que nous deux, à se la couler douce comme quand on était jeunes mariés, juste avant la naissance de George."

en: "......Like when we were newlyweds, you say?  Starting when...?"
ancien_en: "......Like when we were newlyweds, you say?
Starting when...?"
ancien_fr: "......Comme quand on était jeunes mariés, dis-tu ?
À partir de quand... ?"

en: Rather than a short spear, you might call it a thick icepick.
ancien_en: Some people might have likened it to a thick icepick, rather than a short spear.

en: "Yeah...
Damn it, ...I won't cry anymore...
Tears of regret, tears of sadness, I won't shed them again...
...Aah, it's all useless.
The witch's got me backed into a corner.
I'm always on the defensive...!
And that's useless, it's all useless!
I'll spin the chessboard around...!!
That bastard probably thinks we'll be running scared like sheep until tomorrow before we try anything.
...But guess what, I'll spin it around!!
That bastard can't escape this island until tomorrow either...!
We won't be hiding away, pissing ourselves, that bastard will!
I'll expose you, you'll see.
By tomorrow,
...no, screw tomorrow.  Tonight."

Je vais faire pivoter l'échiquier... !!
Ce salaud s'imagine sûrement qu'on va trembler comme des moutons jusqu'à demain avant de tenter quoi que ce soit.

Ce salaud peut pas quitter cette île avant demain, lui non plus... !
C'est pas nous qui allons nous cacher en pissant dans notre froc, c'est lui !
Je vais te démasquer, tu vas voir.
D'ici demain,
...non, au diable demain.
Ce soir."

en: ...Right there, a handle with a demon-shaped design was buried into his chest.
ancien_en: ...Right there...was a handle with a demonic design engraved in it...
ancien_fr: ...Juste là... se trouvait un manche gravé d'un motif démoniaque...

en: The same type of weapon that had been stabbed into Eva and Hideyoshi's foreheads...was in Kanon's chest...
ancien_en: As Kanon looked down at his chest, the same type of weapon that had been stabbed into Eva and Hideyoshi's foreheads was...
ancien_fr: Quand Kanon baissa les yeux sur sa poitrine, le même type d'arme que celle plantée dans le front d'Eva et Hideyoshi était...

en: @:dwave_eng 0, but_1e1229:
@:dwave_eng 0, but_1e1230:
ancien_en: ".........Maria, let me ask this one more time.
You'll probably answer the same anyway, but I'll ask just once more."
ancien_fr: ".........Maria, je vais te le redemander.
Tu vas sûrement répondre la même chose, mais je te le demande une dernière fois."

en: "So the one who killed Kanon-kun...is this Beatrice who supposedly gave you that letter yesterday?!
Where is she?!
Where's she hiding?!
I'll find her and tear her apart!!!
Tell me!!  You know who the culprit really is, don't you?!!
ancien_en: "So the one who killed Kanon-kun...is this Beatrice who supposedly gave you that letter yesterday?!
Where is she?!
Where's she hiding?!
I'll find her and tear her apart!!!
Tell me!!
You know who the culprit really is, don't you?!!
ancien_fr: "Alors celle qui a tué Kanon-kun... c'est cette Beatrice qui t'aurait donné cette lettre hier ?!
Elle est où ?!
Elle se cache où ?!
Je vais la trouver et la mettre en pièces !!!
Dis-le-moi !!
Tu sais qui est vraiment le coupable, hein ?!!

en: "...Maria, I don't mind you being talkative, but let's leave it at that for now.
...I'll bet this is all a pretty happy situation for you, since you're always going on about how witches exist, but keep that to yourself for now.
Don't try to force that on other people."
ancien_en: "...Maria, I don't mind you being talkative, but let's leave it at that for now.
...I'll bet this is all a pretty happy situation for you, since you're always going on about how witches exist,
but keep that to yourself for now.
Don't try to force that on other people."
ancien_fr: "...Maria, ça me dérange pas que tu sois bavarde, mais restons-en là pour l'instant.
...Je parie que toute cette situation te rend bien heureuse, toi qui répètes tout le temps que les sorcières existent,
mais garde ça pour toi pour le moment.
Essaie pas d'imposer ça aux autres."

en: "...We didn't want to disturb the scene, so we didn't investigate that closely.  We can't eliminate the possibility that someone stole a key from them."
ancien_en: "...We didn't want to disturb the scene, so we didn't investigate that closely.
We can't eliminate the possibility that someone stole a key from them."
ancien_fr: "...On voulait pas toucher à la scène, alors on n'a pas regardé d'aussi près.
On peut pas exclure que quelqu'un leur ait volé une clé."

en: ...I always thought she meant Grandfather's imaginary witch..."
ancien_en: ...I always figured she meant a witch that Grandfather had imagined up, but..."
ancien_fr: ...J'ai toujours cru qu'elle parlait d'une sorcière que Grand-père s'était imaginée, mais..."

en: ......The Master surely had feelings of deep love for her.
There can be no mistake that he cared for her more than his late wife."
ancien_en: ......I believe the Master was indeed in love.
Those feelings were certainly stronger than what he felt for his late wife."
ancien_fr: ......Je crois que le Maître était en effet amoureux.
Ces sentiments étaient certainement plus forts que ceux qu'il éprouvait pour feu son épouse."

en: By acting as though Beatrice's soul at least had been restored...
and existed inside this mansion,
ancien_en: Had they been soothing Grandfather's tortured heart,
ancien_fr: Est-ce qu'ils avaient apaisé le cœur tourmenté de Grand-père,

en: ...they might have hoped to soothe Grandfather's heart...
ancien_en: acting as though Beatrice's soul at least had been restored...
and existed inside this mansion...?
ancien_fr: en faisant comme si l'âme de Beatrice, au moins, avait été ramenée...
et existait dans ce manoir... ?

en: With closed eyes and the expression of one remembering something from the distant past,
ancien_en: Though Genji-san closed his eyes, wearing the expression of one remembering the distant past,
ancien_fr: Genji-san a fermé les yeux, avec l'expression de quelqu'un qui se remémore un passé lointain,

en: ...Genji had broken his long silence.
ancien_en: ...he said nothing further.
ancien_fr: ...mais il n'a rien dit de plus.

en: ......In making that confession, he probably felt like he was betraying his one and only Master in the most serious way, even though that person was already dead.
ancien_en: ......He probably felt that making such a confession would be the worst sort of betrayal against his one and only Master, even though that Master was already dead.
ancien_fr: ......Il estimait sans doute que faire un tel aveu serait la pire des trahisons envers son seul et unique Maître, même si ce Maître était déjà mort.

en: ......and would take that with him to the grave.
ancien_en: ......and would follow through with that decision to the grave.
ancien_fr: ......et resterait fidèle à cette décision jusque dans la tombe.

en: "Ridiculous!  That's insane!!
When you die, it's over, right?!
The dead don't come back to life.
Isn't that a miracle humanity's been chasing after for thousands of years and still hasn't accomplished?!
So is this what it means?
Something like, you'll be able to meet them in the afterlife, where they'll be restored?!"
ancien_en: "Ridiculous!
That's insane!!
When you die, it's over, right?!
The dead don't come back to life.
Isn't that a miracle humanity's been chasing after for thousands of years and still hasn't accomplished?!
So is this what it means?
Something like, you'll be able to meet them in the afterlife, where they'll be restored?!"
ancien_fr: "N'importe quoi !
C'est complètement dingue !!
Quand on meurt, c'est fini, non ?!
Les morts ne reviennent pas à la vie.
C'est pas un miracle après lequel l'humanité court depuis des milliers d'années sans jamais y arriver ?!
Alors c'est ça que ça veut dire ?
Un truc du genre, on pourra les retrouver dans l'au-delà, où ils seront ressuscités ?!"

en: "Yeah, that's it exactly.
...If the culprit was one of those four,
setting that letter right in the middle of the table would be both risky and meaningless."
ancien_en: "Yeah, that's it exactly.
...If the culprit was one of those four, setting that letter right in the middle of the table would be both risky and meaningless."
ancien_fr: "Ouais, c'est exactement ça.
...Si le coupable était l'un de ces quatre-là, poser cette lettre en plein milieu de la table aurait été à la fois risqué et absurde."

en: "It was locked when we got here...  But then, how did Beatrice get into the parlor?!!"
ancien_en: "It was locked when we got here...
But then, how did Beatrice get into the parlor?!!"
ancien_fr: "Elle était fermée à clé quand on est arrivés...
Mais alors, comment Beatrice est-elle entrée dans le salon ?!!"

en: ...With this, everything is over, Beatrice.
Congratulations, ...congratulations.
...So lead me.  Lead me to the Golden Land you told me of...
...right now...!!"
ancien_en: ...With this, everything is over, Beatrice.
Congratulations, ...congratulations.
...So lead me.
Lead me to the Golden Land you told me of...
...right now...!!"
ancien_fr: ...Avec ça, tout est terminé, Beatrice.
Félicitations, ...félicitations.
...Alors guide-moi.
Guide-moi jusqu'à la Terre dorée dont tu m'as parlé...
...tout de suite... !!"
